verdict.rationale: Nix is a CLI- and language-driven package manager with no product UI whose features an API would need to match, so UI/API parity is a category error for this kind of product. The official CLI (nix build, nix develop, nix run, etc.) is the primary interface, not a secondary surface trailing a UI. The only graphical component is the NixOS installer ISO, which is not a management UI, and no evidence shows Nix ships an API meant to mirror a UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
